notes.title: New Game Announced
notes.notes:
I’m excited to announce that I am currently working on what I consider to be one of my “dream games.”

[b]As Time Surrenders[/b] (aka No Sun To Worship 2) is a much bigger project with a lot more polish than my previous games. It’s a new type of challenge that has pushed me beyond my usual methods and routines.

I wrote a free article with a lot more info: https://www.patreon.com/posts/what-is-as-time-101120200

Let's goooo!

notes.title: Water is life and death is permanent in this tense, laconic, $3 sci-fi adventure
notes.notes: I was immediately intrigued by It Comes In Waves on seeing its screenshots and early gameplay on developer Antonio Freyre's Twitter. It has a dusty, analogue, desert sci-fi setting reminiscent of Dune and Star Wars' iconic ripping-off of Dune. After playing it, I'm happy to say I can heartily recommend this brief, creative exercise in tension and dread... Read more.
